title: KL10 I/O channels, RH20 and Massbus
summary: Reference set for channel-visible memory addressing, RH20 command lists, DMA completion/error behavior and Massbus controller expectations.
procedure: Use the Processor Reference KL10 system-operations chapter for channel and RH20 programmer-visible behavior.
Use DEC STD 159 for Massbus protocol details when the question is bus/controller semantics.
Use Cornwell kx10_rh.c and kx10_df.c as secondary implementation references, especially NXM completion behavior.
invariants: DMA must respect installed physical memory boundaries.
Channel NXM must be reported through channel status/completion semantics rather than silently materializing memory.
Do not confuse CPU virtual paging with channel physical-address behavior.
